description: Analyze a SysML v2 / KerML document, or the whole workspace, and list the errors, warnings and hints: syntax, unresolved names, type and constraint violations. Positions are 1-based lines and columns.

path.description: one document, absolute or relative to the workspace root; omitted, every document of the workspace

name: workspace_diagnostics

code.description: the stable identifier of the check

end.description: character after the span (1-based line and column)

start.description: first character of the span (1-based line and column)

source.description: the pass that produced the diagnostic
